properties.displayName: [AIOps] Enforce Alert Rule Naming Convention (OpsGenie Format)
properties.description: Denies or audits metric alert rule creation that does not comply with the OpsGenie-integrated naming standard. Required format: <Acronym>-OPSGENIE-YES/NO-<ENV>-<MetricName> on <ResourceID>. Examples: ABC-OPSGENIE-YES-PROD-Percentage CPU on my-test-vm | DEF-OPSGENIE-NO-DEV-Blob Capacity on mytest/blob

metadata.description: List of approved team/customer acronyms that may appear as the first segment before '-'. Must be uppercase. Example: ['ABC', 'DEF']
List of approved environment labels that must appear as the third segment (-ENV-). Must be uppercase. Example: ['PROD', 'DEV', 'TEST']
Deny, Audit or Disabled. Use Audit first during rollout, then switch to Deny.

allOf.comment: Target only metric alert rules. Log-based alerts (scheduledQueryRules) are out of scope.
Rule 1: Name must begin with one of the allowed team acronyms followed by '-'. Evaluated by iterating the allowedAcronyms parameter.
Rule 2: Name must contain the OpsGenie routing indicator as the second segment — either -OPSGENIE-YES- or -OPSGENIE-NO-.
Rule 3: Name must contain one of the allowed environment labels as the third segment, bounded by '-' on each side.
Rule 4: Name must contain ' on ' — the separator between the metric name (4th segment) and the resource identifier.
